script.analysis: All 23,026 stored characters read in two contiguous ranges with canonical hash match. Reaction compilation: cold open teases clips (Robbie's Elantra, $1,200 payment "you only live once", $14K/month Lamborghini lease). Narrator segments after each clip: 84-month Kia with Edmunds context and refinance-hope critique; V8 owner opportunity cost; 24.1% CarMax Mustang plus $770 insurance; dealer "financing for life" promo genre; repossessed uninsured Challenger; 20% APR Civic vs interviewer's cheaper M3 ("your terms are the car"); unemployed BMW owner ("payment must survive your worst month"); underwater X5 and a 60/40 rental-split offer; Tahoe/truck couple and voluntary repossession; dealer promo montage; three luxury cars $7,700/month; $100K M3 at 6.7% for 72 months; rolled negative equity on a Jeep; radio call-in about a $30K truck on $45K salary and unwinding unfunded deals; Lamborghini lease finale; end-screen CTA. Narration is sharp, specific and educational per clip (terms, depreciation, gap insurance, deficiency balances, spot delivery), but relies wholly on third-party footage, includes mocking of identifiable people, and has a few numeric mismatches. Clip audio ASR includes profanity and fragments; not audio-verified.

claim_audit: 0:11500 Edmunds-style record average new payment $777, 1 in 5 over $1,000 and nearly a quarter at 84+ months consistent with Edmunds 2025-2026 reporting; not re-accessed. $1,200/month for 10 years at ~10% = ~$245,800 ("quarter million by mid-30s") - requires a 10% return (7% gives ~$207,700). $556 + $770 = $1,326 correct. $700 x 60 = $42,000 correct. $48,000 owed - $35,000 value = $13,000 underwater correct. "$1,000 down on $30,000 = owing 97%" correct before taxes/fees.

11500:23026 Truck: $78,000 at 14% for 72 months gives ~$1,607/month, matching $1,600; but after ~46 payments (Aug 2022 to mid-2026) the balance would be ~$36,000, so "still owes about $74,000" implies the clip was recorded early in the loan, and "almost every payment eaten by interest" overstates for a mid-2026 viewpoint (clip date unknown). Voluntary repossession still damages credit and leaves deficiency balances - correct. $3,100 + $2,900 + $1,700 = $7,700/month and x12 = $92,400 correct. $1,500 x 72 = $108,000 correct.

11500:23026 Narrator calls the Jeep buyer "an attorney"; the stored clip text does not state an occupation (may be on-screen, unverified). Lamborghini clip audio says "It's 50K" down while narration says "$250,000 down" - unreconciled. "$30,000 truck on $45,000 salary = 2/3 of gross" compares a purchase price with annual income while the cited rule (10-15% of take-home) concerns annual car cost - mismatched comparison. No legal cooling-off period for most car purchases and unwinding before funding is broadly accurate as general guidance; state rules vary.
